verdict.rationale: Zero is an email client, so saved snippets or templates are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions snippets, templates, variables or template attachments. AI-assisted compose and draft creation are adjacent features: they generate or save individual emails rather than offering reusable reply templates.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can insert saved snippets or templates — with variables and attachments — instead of retyping the same reply
